informal_statement: For \(0<\lambda<1\) and admissible \(\beta\), the type-\(\mathrm B\) radius equals \(\lambda+\sqrt{1-\lambda^2}\cot\beta\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:81-91`: The sine addition formula, \(\cos (\arccos (\lambda ))=\lambda\), and positive \(\sin (\beta )\) give \(\lambda +\sqrt{1-\lambda ^2}\cdot \cot (\beta )\). Both density hypotheses and angular admissibility are present in the translation.
